items.summary: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA/auto-ontology 是一个 Python 框架，可在数据之上构建语义图推理层，让 LLM 与智能体工作流的查询生成更确定、上下文检索更准、结果更可解释。
items.recommend_reason_en: NVIDIA/auto-ontology is a Python framework for semantic graph-based reasoning layers over data, with deterministic query generation and explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows, making it worth opening to explore.

items.recommend_reason_zh: Render Sandboxes 为每个智能体提供一台计算机，值得打开看看代理如何获得自己的计算环境。
items.recommend_reason_en: Render Sandboxes gives each agent its own computer, according to its description, and is worth opening to see how isolated agent environments could be provisioned.

items.summary: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
items.recommend_reason_zh: Worktrunk 是一款面向并行 AI 代理工作流的 Git worktree 管理 CLI，适合需要同时处理多个分支任务的开发者打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: max-sixty/worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows, and is worth opening if you want a tool built around that use case.

items.summary: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude
items.recommend_reason_zh: Floot Payments 能在 ChatGPT 和 Claude 构建的应用里完成收款，想让 AI 应用具备付费能力的开发者值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Floot Payments lets you take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude, making it worth opening if you want payment support inside those assistant-built apps.
